title: Upfront Share for Special-Order Color and Glass
content:
# Upfront Share for Special-Order Color and Glass

Window Replacement Contracts. In the required booking deposit of a contract paid by cash, check or card, the special-order upfront share is the portion taken up front of the part of the contract's exterior color and laminated glass lines that the deposit percentage leaves uncovered.

**Rule.** The special-order upfront share is the paint upfront share of 1.0 when the contract carries an exterior color line, the glass upfront share of 0.5 when it carries a laminated glass line and no exterior color line, and nothing otherwise.

| Lines on the contract | Special-order upfront share |
|---|---|
| An exterior color line | 1.0 |
| A laminated glass line, no exterior color line | 0.5 |
| Neither | Nothing |

## Hypothetical figure

With a deposit percentage of 25% and laminated glass lines of $800 (no exterior color), the uncovered part is $600 and the share of 0.5 takes $300 up front.
